import json, sys

import solver, controller, probability

def find_neg_cycle(mcf):
    n = mcf.n
    edges = []
    for u in range(n):
        for ei in mcf.adj[u]:
            if mcf.cap[ei] > 0:
                edges.append((u, mcf.to[ei], mcf.cost[ei]))
    dist = [0]*n; pred = [-1]*n; last = -1
    for i in range(n):
        last = -1
        for (u, v, c) in edges:
            if dist[u] + c < dist[v]:
                dist[v] = dist[u] + c; pred[v] = u; last = v
        if last == -1:
            return None
    v = last
    for _ in range(n): v = pred[v]
    cyc = []
    u = v
    while True:
        cyc.append((u, pred[u], dist[u]))
        u = pred[u]
        if u == v: break
    return cyc

orig_spfa = solver.MCF.spfa_pi
cnt = [0]
def spfa(self, pi):
    cnt[0] += 1
    cyc = find_neg_cycle(self)
    if cyc is None:
        print(f'call {cnt[0]}: no negative cycle')
    else:
        print(f'call {cnt[0]}: NEGATIVE CYCLE len {len(cyc)}: {cyc[:6]}')
    res = orig_spfa(self, pi)
    return res
solver.MCF.spfa_pi = spfa
